_meta: BH CE 固化查询集(导入后界面 Analysis→Saved Queries 常驻)。来源:12 号附录已验证 + Exchange/ADFS 猎杀新增。

queries.name: 🔴 可烤的非高权用户(Kerberoast)
queries.query: MATCH (u:User {hasspn:true}) WHERE NOT (u)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group {highvalue:true}) RETURN u.name, u.description
queries.description: SPN 账户且不在高权组 — Kerberoast 首选目标

queries.name: 🔴 AS-REP 可烤账户
queries.description: 无预认证 — GetNPUsers 直接抓哈希

queries.name: 🟠 无约束委托机器
queries.description: 抓 DC 票即通吃;排除 DC 后全是目标

queries.name: 🟠 RBCD 候选(可控写边→机器)
queries.description: 有写边即可打 RBCD 三步链

queries.name: 🟠 DACL 滥用边总览
queries.description: 全图高价值 ACL 边

queries.name: 🔴 DCSync 路径
queries.description: 已有复制权 — 直接 secretsdump -just-dc

queries.name: 🔴 DCSync 候选(双 GetChanges)
queries.description: 同时有 GetChanges+All = 可 DCSync

queries.name: 🟠 GPO 控制边
queries.description: 可改 GPO = SharpGPOAbuse 定向下发

queries.name: 🟠 GPO→OU 影响面
queries.description: 控制 GPO 且看它挂到哪个 OU

queries.name: 🔴 最短路径到 DA(干净边集)
queries.description: 参数 $DA 填 'DOMAIN ADMINS@X.LOCAL' — 攻击路径主查询

queries.name: 🟡 孤立 adminCount=1
queries.description: 曾是管理员的高权残留账户

queries.name: 🟣 Exchange 服务器(攻击面入口)
queries.query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'EXCH' OR c.name CONTAINS 'MAIL' OR ANY(r IN [(c)-[:MemberOf]->(g) | g.name] WHERE r CONTAINS 'EXCHANGE') RETURN c.name, c.operatingsystem
queries.description: Exchange 服务器定位 — ProxyLogon/Shell 系列与规则攻击入口

queries.name: 🟣 Exchange Trusted Subsystem 成员
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.name CONTAINS 'EXCHANGE TRUSTED SUBSYSTEM' RETURN p
queries.description: 该组成员 ≈ 域内通用管理权(可任意机器 psexec 类操作)

queries.name: 🟣 Exchange Windows Permissions 成员
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.name CONTAINS 'EXCHANGE WINDOWS PERMISSIONS' RETURN p
queries.description: 该组对域对象有 WriteDacl — ACL 提权经典起点

queries.name: 🟣 ADFS 服务器定位
queries.query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'ADFS' OR c.name CONTAINS 'STS' RETURN c.name, c.operatingsystem
queries.description: ADFS 服务器 — DCSync svc 账户→ADFSDump→伪造令牌链入口

queries.name: 🟣 ADFS 服务账户(gMSA/委托)
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name CONTAINS 'ADFS' OR u.name CONTAINS 'SVC' AND (u:hasspn OR u:User {unconstraineddelegation:true}) RETURN u.name, u.hasspn, u.dontreqpreauth
queries.description: ADFS/GMSA 服务账户 — token signing 证书持有者
